targets.outcome_quote: This direct replication of Dzulkifli and Mustafar (2013) failed to detect significant effects of colour priming on memory span or sustained attention in a sample of 60 Indian university undergraduates. Warm colour (red) background did not enhance cognitive performance relative to cool colour (blue) or white control conditions.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly report failure to detect the two predicted effects. Low power is discussed, but authors explicitly say their null findings are informative. Target citation is unresolved because the sole Dzulkifli/Mustafar entry is a review, not the empirical primary study attributed in the prose.
